item.description: Former India cricketer Robin Uthappa believes Arshdeep Singh should replace Harshit Rana in the Indian team. item.description: A senior Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) official has stirred controversy by terming former captain Tamim Iqbal as "an Indian agent". item.title: WATCH: Sunil Gavaskar keeps his promise; joins Jemimah Rodrigues for sing-along session
item.description: Jemimah Rodrigues played a key role in India’s maiden Women’s World Cup triumph last year. The highlight of her performance was the knock of 127* against Australia in the semi-final in Navi Mumbai, where India chased down a world record 338 runs. Before the World Cup final, Gavaskar had promised that he would sing alongside Jemimah on guitar if India lift the coveted title.
